verses.text: Miriam and Aaron began to speak against Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married, for he had married a woman from Cush.
They said, "Has the LORD spoken only through Moses? Hasn't he spoken through us too?" And the LORD heard what they said.
Now Moses was a very humble man, more humble than anyone else on earth.
Suddenly the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, "All three of you, come out to the Tent of Meeting." So the three of them went out.
The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud and stood at the door of the Tent. He called Aaron and Miriam, and they both stepped forward.
He said, "Listen to what I say. When there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, show myself to him in visions and speak to him in dreams.
But it is not like that with my servant Moses. He is faithful in all my house.
With him I speak face to face, clearly and not in riddles. He even sees what the LORD looks like. So why were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?"
The LORD was very angry with them, and he left.
When the cloud lifted from above the Tent, Miriam's skin was suddenly covered with a disease, white like snow. Aaron turned toward her and saw that she had the skin disease.
He said to Moses, "Please, my master, do not punish us for this sin we have so foolishly done.
Do not let her be like a baby born dead, with half its flesh eaten away."
So Moses cried out to the LORD, "O God, please heal her!"
The LORD answered Moses, "If her father had spat in her face, would she not be in disgrace for seven days? Keep her outside the camp for seven days. After that she may be brought back."
So Miriam was kept outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until she was brought back.
After that, the people left Hazeroth and camped in the desert of Paran.
